projects.title: LifeOS – AI Healthcare Platform
projects.shortDescription: Comprehensive AI healthcare platform unifying symptom analysis, medical record comprehension, personalized fitness and nutrition guidance, and medication management.
bullets: Developing an AI healthcare platform covering symptom analysis, medical record understanding, personalized fitness and nutrition recommendations, medication management, and health tracking.
Integrating Generative AI, NLP, and recommendation systems to turn user health data into personalized insights and summaries across multiple wellness modules.

projects.title: AI Resume Intelligence
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack resume screening platform with spaCy NLP extraction, TF-IDF job role prediction, candidate ranking, and PDF export.
bullets: Built a full-stack resume screening platform where candidates upload PDF resumes and recruiters search and rank candidates by job role and skills.
Implemented NLP extraction with spaCy (NER, skill matching), TF-IDF job role prediction, a weighted 100-point ranking algorithm, JWT role-based authentication, and PDF report export.

projects.title: RAG-Based Study Assistant
projects.shortDescription: Locally running, privacy-preserving study assistant for semantic PDF document Q&A with source citations using Ollama and local LLM.
bullets: Developed a locally running, RAG-based study assistant that enables users to upload PDF documents and ask questions grounded in their content.
Integrated Ollama with a local LLM and semantic retrieval to generate document-based answers with source citations, supporting offline use without paid AI APIs.
